title: T2-T3 ROM in T1-T4 4-vertebra segment at +/-4 Nm (Busscher 2009)

quantity.name: ROM
quantity.definition: range of angular deflection of the middle motion segment between the maximum moments in positive and negative direction (+/-4 Nm, full range), 3rd cycle; mean (SD) of 6

source.authors: Busscher I, van Dieen JH, Kingma I, van der Veen AJ, Verkerke GJ, Veldhuizen AG
source.sample: 6 male fresh-frozen T1-L4 spines, each cut into four 4-vertebra segments (T1-T4, T5-T8, T9-T12, L1-L4); ~3 cm of ribs kept with costotransverse and costovertebral joints; mildly degenerated on CT

protocol.summary: End vertebrae (3 endplate screws) embedded in low-melting-alloy cups with the segment hanging freely (tension-free neutral curvature); segment horizontal in a custom 4-point bending device on a Zwick TC-FR2.5TN (rotated 90 deg for LB); AR via a steel cable on the cranial cup. 250 N axial compressive preload for 1 h before testing, then removed (no preload during bending). Displacement controlled at 0.5 deg/s, reversed at +/-4 Nm; 3 continuous cycles, 3rd analysed. Optotrak 3020 LED markers on each vertebral body; rotation of the middle intervertebral joint (middle 2 vertebrae) in local axes.
how_to_simulate: Model the 4-vertebra segment with ~3 cm rib stumps and costovertebral/costotransverse joints (thoracic) or the plain L1-L4 segment; no rib cage
Fix the caudal end vertebra; apply pure moment +/-4 Nm to the cranial end vertebra, no preload
Report rotation of the middle segment between +4 and -4 Nm (full range)
protocol.notes: Values digitised from Figs 2-4 (bar = mean, whisker = +SD), n = 6 per region. Middle level inferred from 'middle intervertebral joint, calculated from the middle 2 vertebrae'. NZ stiffness (Fig. 5) and flexibility between 3.5 and 4 Nm (Fig. 6) not extracted. The same 6 donors supply all four regions.

extraction.check_notes: Embedded raster figures (300 dpi) extracted at native resolution; bar tops and SD caps located by pixel analysis against y ticks 0-8 deg (~52 px/deg). Discussion quotes lumbar (L1-L4) ROM of about 5 deg FE, 6 deg LB and 2 deg AR, matching 5.17 / 5.89 / 2.20.

loading.preload: none during bending (250 N for 1 h before testing)
loading.device: custom 4-point bending device on Zwick materials testing machine; Optotrak 3020

ribcage.intact_structures: ~3 cm rib stumps with costovertebral and costotransverse joints
